content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: inference-api p99 latency > 3.2s sustained for 10m. PD incident INC-9427. link: https://alerts.redwood/INC-9427 :rotating_light:
Priya K: acked — I'm oncall and taking this. starting triage now.
pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by Priya K (on-call). Estimated impact: p99 latency breach, no widespread 5xx reported yet.
Sam T: quick note — seeing queue buildup on tokenization sidecar (eu-west-1) around 14:00 UTC, CPU ~92% on sidecar-02.
Marcos: can you paste tail latencies from the sidecar? also check KV eviction counters.
Sam T: tail sample from sidecar logs:
```
2026-03-15T14:03:12Z sidecar-02 WARNING request_latency_ms=3245 queue_len=18 cpu=91.7
2026-03-15T14:04:02Z sidecar-02 WARNING request_latency_ms=4570 queue_len=22 cache_miss=true
```
Priya K: got it. I'm scaling sidecar replicas +2 in eu-west and temporarily reducing token_batch_size to 8.
Ava L: I'm going to add a temporary route to model-fallback-small in us-west to drop pressure on main pools (costy but quick).
Priya K: issuing k8s command now: `kubectl scale deployment/sidecar -n inference-eu --replicas=5` (starting).
Jules R: small runtime tweak: lowering batching max_delay to 5ms to reduce head-of-line latency — preparing patch.
Sam T: also seeing a spike in KV eviction rate at ~14:01 UTC, might be eviction due to memory pressure. checking autoscaler events and recent config changes.
Marcos: customer impact summary: roughly 2.3% of requests experienced >3s latency, ~0.1% observed 502s. Most customers unaffected but a handful of enterprise routes crossed SLO.
Priya K: tagging @support-team to prep potential customer comms (do not send outbound yet).
support-bot: Support notified — drafting message templates and impact blurb.
Ava L: sidecar replicas are up; CPU on sidecar-02 trending down to ~64%. p95 has returned to ~800ms and p99 is moving toward ~2s.
Priya K: can someone run a KV warm on popular prefixes? warming should reduce cache misses.
Sam T: kicking off warm script: `./tools/warm_cache.py --prefixes popular.json` — warming in progress.
Priya K: summary so far for handoff: likely root cause = KV cache eviction combined with sidecar CPU backpressure; mitigations applied = scaled sidecars, reroute to fallback model, warmed cache, reduced batch size. p99 dropped from ~4.5s -> ~1.8s after changes.
Ava L: I'll take over monitoring at 15:00 UTC and keep the PD incident open for verification. I'll also coordinate post-incident RCA.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident INC-9427 acknowledged by Priya K, assigned to schedule 'eng-oncall'.
pagerduty-bot: Auto-escalation temporarily disabled during active mitigation window.
Priya K: leaving runbook notes in INC-9427 and #incidents; handoff to Ava for follow-up. If p99 climbs again ping me directly.
Ava L: taking over — setting 10m check-ins and alert for p99 > 2.5s. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Alert muted for 30m while active mitigations are in place (auto-snooze).
Ava L: p99 now ~1.6s, p95 430ms, no new 502s in last 5m. If stable for next 20m I'll mark as resolved.
incident-bot: Alert resolved: p99 latency back under threshold. Incident INC-9427 remains open for post-incident analysis and RCA prep.
